_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family — exterior caulking as standalone LF-based line item. No existing SF_ entry. Domain: exterior. Phase scope: apply (single product application — not prime/finish). No quality tier dimension.

paintable_items.name: Exterior Caulk Joint
paintable_items.notes: New item — no existing ITM_ covers a caulk joint. LF is the natural UOM for linear sealant application. The surface_ref is also proposed (no existing surface_id for caulk joints).

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_CAULK exists as a generic closet shelf task but TSK_CAULK_* prefix is unused. The CAULK abbreviation is distinct from the existing TSK_CAULK generic pattern.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_CAULK_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (PROTECT_GROUND, JOINT_CLEAN, APPLY_SIMPLE, INSPECT)

paintscope_keys.description: Total linear feet of exterior caulk joints in scope
paintscope_keys.notes: Direct capture input — estimator enters joint LF during takeoff. No existing PS_EXT key for caulk LF. Derivation from trim/opening keys is optional and outside the spec's scope.

paintscope_keys.description: Subset of total joint LF requiring backer rod installation (joints > 3/8 inch wide)
paintscope_keys.notes: Optional input. Defaults to 0 if not provided (all joints treated as simple_bead). Drives joint_complexity split.

paintscope_keys.description: Primary sealant type for paintable joints
paintscope_keys.notes: Enum selection — one of: acrylic_latex, siliconized_acrylic, polyurethane, hybrid_ms. Drives material system selection and scheduling gate (polyurethane cure).

applicable_enums._note: Filtered to SF_CAULK_EXT scope. No quality_tier, no sheen, no substrate_state, no application_method. This is a simple non-coating spec.

phase.notes: Uses 'apply' (generic coating phase) because caulking is neither prime nor finish. 'finish' phase used for inspection module only.

task_classification.notes: All tasks in this spec are 'binary' — no quality tier dimension means no qt_conditional or qt_scaled tasks. Full list included per resolver convention.

unit_of_measure.notes: LF for all joint-based tasks. FIXED for cleanup allowance.

product_role.notes: Sealant is classified as 'specialty' — it is not primer, finish, sealer, clear, or stain. It is a standalone sealing product.

surface_ids.notes: Primary surface 'caulk_joint_exterior' is proposed — no existing surface_id for caulk joints. Adjacent surfaces are all existing entries in the registry.

zone_ids.notes: Drop cloth below caulking work area. Not the same as ext_landscape_adjacent (which is landscape protection for spray/paint drip). ext_ground_cover is minimal edge-only protection for caulk drips.
Tape masking on adjacent finished surfaces for clean sealant lines. Conditional — active when caulking against already-finished surfaces.

material_system_prefix.notes: No existing SYS_ entries for caulk/sealant products. All 4 material systems are new. Named by sealant type since that is the primary configuration dimension (replaces quality_tier as the material driver).

consumable_prefix.notes: CON_DROP_CLOTH_CANVAS reusable for ground protection. CON_MASKING_TAPE_BLUE reusable for adjacent surface masking. CON_CAULK_TUBE is a new consumable (spec-specific sealant tube, distinct from CON_CAULK_PAINTABLE which is interior/generic). CON_CAULK_BACKER_ROD, CON_CAULK_GUN, CON_CAULK_TAPE are new.

round_configurations.notes: Caulking is a single-pass operation — no round configurations needed. There are no primer/finish coat sequences. One bead of sealant per joint, one pass.

coverage_profiles.notes: No formal coverage profiles needed. Sealant yield is measured in LF/tube (not SF/gallon like paint). Yield data belongs in materials.json consumable entries, not as COV_ profiles.

xspec_flags_set.description: Set when all caulk joints are applied and skinned/cured. Adjacent painting specs should check this flag before applying finish coats over caulked joints.
Set when sealant_type = polyurethane. Signals 3-7 day cure delay before finish coats. Blocks painting spec finish phases.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Caulking sets flags consumed by exterior painting specs (trim, siding, window). Caulking does not consume flags from other specs. No COMP_ modifiers — caulking rate is independent of adjacent spec complexity.

materials_json.notes: material_systems keyed by sealant_type (not quality_tier). applies_when uses sealant_type dimension. Use 'consumables' key (never 'consumable_usage_models').

production_json.notes: No quality_tier_effects needed (no QT dimension). Factor modifiers for joint_complexity drive rate selection between simple_bead and backer_rod tasks.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: SYS_ applies_when.sealant_type MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions (no quality_tier for this spec)
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup > prep > apply > finish > cleanup (no prime or interstage for this spec)
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_CAULK_ prefix per this resolution
RULE 10: ITM_CAULK_JOINT must use exact registered ID in spec.json
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Caulking (New Construction)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family — exterior caulking is a standalone line item not covered by any existing SF_. Crosses all exterior surface boundaries (trim, siding, windows, corners, penetrations).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Caulk Joint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM_ covers a caulk joint. The closest items (ITM_TRIM_*, ITM_WINDOW_*) are painted surfaces, not joints between surfaces.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior caulk joint surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing surface_id for caulk joints. Needed for adjacency declarations. Caulk joints are a distinct surface type — they are the boundary between other surfaces.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior ground cover protection
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Distinct from ext_landscape_adjacent (which is spray overspray protection). ext_ground_cover is minimal drop cloth for caulk drips — edge_only level. Could be reused by other exterior specs needing ground drip protection without full landscape coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Adjacent finished surface tape masking
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Tape masking along joint edges on finished exterior surfaces. Not covered by existing zones — wall_adjacent is interior, ext_landscape_adjacent is ground-level landscape, not surface-to-surface joint masking.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Total exterior caulk joint linear feet
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing PS_EXT key for caulk joint LF. Needed as direct capture input for caulk scope takeoff.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Backer rod joint linear feet subset
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Subset of total joint LF requiring backer rod. Drives joint_complexity configuration split.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Sealant type enum selection
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Enum input for sealant type selection. Drives material system selection. No existing PS_EXT_META.ENUM key for sealant type.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Total caulk joint linear feet input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New input — no existing IN_ for caulk joint LF. Maps to PS_EXT_SURFACE_LF.CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Backer rod joint linear feet input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New input — subset of total joint LF requiring backer rod. Maps to PS_EXT_SURFACE_LF.CAULK_JOINT_BACKER_ROD.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Sealant type enum input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New input — sealant type selection. Maps to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.CAULK_SEALANT_TYPE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Latex Sealant System
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing SYS_ for sealant products. Acrylic latex is the baseline sealant type for low-movement joints.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siliconized Acrylic Sealant System
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Mid-range sealant with improved water resistance over straight acrylic.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Polyurethane Sealant System
registry_additions_proposed.justification: High-movement sealant (Class 25/50). Introduces 3-7 day cure scheduling gate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Hybrid MS Polymer Sealant System
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Premium paintable sealant combining silicone durability with paintability.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Sealant Tube (10.1 oz)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Distinct from CON_CAULK_PAINTABLE (interior/generic). Exterior sealant tubes are spec-specific consumables tied to sealant_type selection.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Closed-Cell Backer Rod
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New consumable — closed-cell foam backer rod for joints > 3/8 inch. No existing CON_ for backer rod.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Caulk Gun (smooth-rod)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Reusable tool tracked as consumable. No existing CON_ for caulk gun.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masking Tape for Clean Caulk Lines
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Could potentially reuse CON_MASKING_TAPE_BLUE, but this is specific to caulk line masking (different usage rate — 60 LF/roll vs standard tape usage). Materials Manager should evaluate whether to reuse CON_MASKING_TAPE_BLUE or keep separate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Caulking complete flag
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Signals to adjacent painting specs that caulk joints are applied and ready for overcoat. New cross-spec coordination flag.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Polyurethane cure scheduling gate
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Signals 3-7 day cure delay when polyurethane sealant is used. Blocks finish coat scheduling on adjacent painting specs.
